description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


See the assets below to download this version and install.
What's Changed
- fix(create-plugin): make the scaffolded .tabularium pass registry validation; point docs at tabularis.dev by @NewtTheWolf in #594
- feat(plugins): extend RpcDriver for BLOB, materialized views, and type mappings by @aesslinger in #576
- feat(connections): opaque plugin-specific extra fields for ConnectionParams by @fuleinist in #596
- ci(release): stop bundling libwayland in the AppImage and reuse build.yml for releases by @debba in #599
- feat(registry): add official MongoDB Atlas plugin by @Robbyfuu in #496
- fix: support parameters in explain plan by @DhruvShah-Dev in #580
- fix: persist empty connection state after disconnect by @fuleinist in #578
- feat(connections): colored tags and environment classification with production safety warning by @pokertour in #473
- fix(datagrid): enable editing tables without a primary key by @debba in #600
- fix(connection-catalogue): clean up engine card layout and naming by @debba in #605
- docs(plugins): .tabularium is the canonical manifest, not manifest.json by @NewtTheWolf in #595
- feat(datagrid): mask sensitive columns in the results grid by @iamthenuggetman in #587
- fix: expand SQLite home paths by @DhruvShah-Dev in #579
- Fix MySQL visual query table qualifiers by @DhruvShah-Dev in #582
- fix(plugins): validate archives before install and improve error recovery by @debba in #609
- chore(plugins): bump DynamoDB plugin to v0.1.5 by @fuleinist in #607
- feat(plugins): add locale-aware plugin README details modal by @debba in #615
Full Changelog: v0.18.0...v0.19.0
